title: Finishing Neck and Shoulder Stroking
summary: Long, light passes connect the posterior neck and shoulders while gradually reducing the intensity of contact.
goal: Finish the sequence calmly and reduce intensity after more active techniques.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of finishing stroking over the posterior neck and shoulders.
startingPosition: The neck and shoulders are relaxed. The palms make gentle contact with the posterior neck and upper shoulders.
instructions: Begin with light contact near the base of the skull or base of the neck.
Glide downward along the posterior neck.
Continue outward over the upper shoulders.
Reduce pressure slightly with each following pass.
Finish with several very light, slow strokes.
direction: From the posterior neck toward the shoulders with gradually decreasing pressure.
warning: Finishing strokes should never be performed through pain. Stop if dizziness, numbness, or other unusual symptoms appear.
telegramCaption: Long, light passes over the neck and shoulders with gradually decreasing pressure.
